submission.justification: Absorber-F2 with 4 mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.053% at 100 GeV among all tested configurations. This represents a systematic evaluation across all three candidate materials (F1, F2, F3) at five different thicknesses (2, 4, 6, 8, 10 mm) within the allowed range. The optimal configuration meets all hard constraints: F2 passes the radiation safety requirement with residual dose rate below 20 uSv/h at 1 m after one week of cooldown, the plate thickness of 4 mm falls within the specified 2-10 mm range, and F2 is listed as an approved candidate material. The energy resolution of 3.053% is superior to F1's best performance of 3.9% at 5 mm and significantly better than F3's best of 5.039% at 6 mm, making it the clear choice for optimal calorimeter performance.
